user.title: Add
user.description: Scan a mailbox for shipping mails, or add API credentials of a carrier for live status.

carrier.title: Choose carrier
carrier.description: Each carrier is added separately with its own API credentials.

mailbox.title: Mailbox
mailbox.description:
Parcels are found in shipping mails from DHL, DPD, GLS, Hermes, UPS, Amazon and shops. Add one entry per mailbox, e.g. a separate one for Amazon.

Gmail, iCloud and Yahoo need an app password. WEB.DE and GMX need IMAP enabled in the mailbox settings.

data_description.provider: Automatic picks the provider from the address. Choose "Other provider" to enter the IMAP server yourself.
data_description.password: Gmail and others with two-factor login need an app password.
data_description.carriers: Only mails about these carriers are evaluated. Amazon covers all Amazon order mails, also when DHL delivers.

mailbox_server.title: IMAP server
mailbox_server.description: Enter the IMAP server of your mail provider. You usually find it in its help pages under IMAP.

reauth_mailbox.title: Mailbox login
reauth_mailbox.description: The mail server rejected the login for {username}. Please enter the password again.

credentials.title: {carrier}
credentials.description: Enter your API credentials for {carrier}. Leave the form empty if none are required.

data_description.api_key: DHL: developer.dhl.com (Shipment Tracking - Unified). GLS: gls-group.eu/DE/en/register-api-access. Hermes: optional.
data_description.client_id: UPS: app from developer.ups.com. Amazon: LWA client ID of your SP-API app.
data_description.refresh_token: LWA refresh token from authorizing your SP-API app.
data_description.business_id: Value of the x-amzn-shipping-business-id header, e.g. AmazonShipping_UK.
data_description.carrier_id: Amazon carrier ID used for tracking, e.g. AMZN_UK.

error.invalid_email: Please enter your full e-mail address.
